english.title: Use a vehicle on a road emitting smoke / vapour / grit / oil / sparks / ashes likely to cause damage injury / danger
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), from which

(A)_[smoke was]_
(B)_[visible vapour was]_
(C)_[grit was]_
(D)_[sparks were]_
(E)_[ashes were]_
(F)_[cinders were]_
(G)_[an oily substance was]_

emitted, when that emission caused or was likely to cause damage to property or injury or danger to any person who was or who might reasonably have been expected to be on the road.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 61(5) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
